text: I just went on a date for first time in six months with a guy that I matched with less than 12 hours ago and I get To the cafe and he is holding These I went on nearly 50 dates last year and not one time Did I ever ever receive flowers? he handed them to me and I just had this look of shock on my face because I'm like What the fuck? Now that I'm dating again, and the love chronicles is making a return. This is the standard I am expecting In general, there is nothing wrong with bringing flowers to a girl if you genuinely want to do it but if you are doing it on the first date because she hinted at it or Because you saw it in a movie and think you're supposed to or because you're afraid showing up without flowers will look wrong Then it's a mistake because what that gesture actually says is I'm not enough on my own I need something extra to impress you. You already invited her, planned the date and will probably take care of the bill That's already solid effort coming from you that a decent girl should appreciate. So bring your good energy, not the flowers Here's the simple rule If you think bringing flowers on the first date will help you seduce her, it won't. In most cases It will do the opposite It puts you in a position of chasing, of trying to earn approval before you even know if she deserves yours Now if you are already seeing the girl or in a relationship and you want to surprise her with flowers, go ahead That's completely fine. But on a first date, no, you don't prove your value with flowers You show it with confidence, presence and self-respect
